name: Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah
contribution: He is widely associated with the consolidation of a unified and independent Bengal Sultanate in the mid-fourteenth century.
context: Political fragmentation in Bengal before the emergence of a sovereign regional sultanate.
impact: His consolidation helped define Bengal as a distinct political entity with lasting institutional and cultural influence.
highlight: Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah unified Bengal's principal sultanates and founded the Ilyas Shahi dynasty.
seoTitle: Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah: Unifier of the Bengal Sultanate
seoDescription: Explore Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah's unification of Bengal and the formation of an independent sultanate in the fourteenth century.
shortAnswer: Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah was the ruler who unified major parts of Bengal and established an independent sultanate in 1352.
